The following events took place in '''4002 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] attack the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Kuar]] and [[Battle of Kuar|conquer]] the world.<ref name="Warfare" />
*Onderon makes contact with the Galactic Republic and encounters galactic civilization.<ref name="TotJ" />
